title: Build apps in Copilot Cowork and Copilot Studio
summary: Build full-stack business apps through conversation in Copilot Cowork and Copilot Studio, grounded in enterprise data.
body_markdown:
AI is changing who can build software. People who could never write code can now describe an idea and generate a working application in minutes, using any number of agentic coding solutions.


But generating an application is only part of the equation. To solve real business problems, applications need to connect to enterprise data and systems, operate securely, and fit within the processes people rely on every day. And as more people become app builders, IT needs the governance and controls to confidently bring those solutions into the enterprise.


That’s why we’re introducing natural language **app building in Copilot Cowork and Copilot Studio** , bringing agentic app creation into the same trusted, connected enterprise platform you already rely on. In Copilot Cowork,[build apps with the new /app skill](https://aka.ms/appsincowork) now available via the[Microsoft Frontier program](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/frontier-program) . In Copilot Studio, build apps alongside agents and workflows to turn ideas into complete business process solutions, rolling out in public preview over the next week.


Whether you start in[Copilot Cowork](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/cowork) or[Copilot Studio](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/microsoft-copilot-studio/) , the same capabilities empower you to start with the outcome you want, shape it through natural conversation, connect it to organizational data, and publish an enterprise-ready, governed solution.


Copilot Studio homepage, with app building now available alongside agents and workflows.[Build enterprise apps with Copilot Studio](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/microsoft-copilot-studio)


## Build an app by describing what you need


App building starts with a conversation. Choose *App (Preview)* from the Copilot Studio home screen or invoke the /app skill in your Copilot Cowork chat. Then, simply describe the business outcome, users, data, and actions you need. Copilot Studio uses agentic coding to turn your intent into a working app scaffold.


From there, you can continue to iterate in natural language, inspect the app in preview, and review the underlying code. The experience is designed to serve a broad spectrum of builders: information workers can stay focused on the solution, while advanced makers and developers can go deeper into the app’s structure and code when they need more control.


The app building experience in Copilot Studio.


## Connect apps to your business data


Apps built with Copilot Cowork and Copilot Studio use connectors to work with your business data, including[using Work IQ to access organizational context](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-copilot-studio/add-work-iq) . This allows makers to turn organizational information into usable, connected experiences—not just surfacing information, but taking action and writing results back to the systems within your Microsoft 365 tenant boundary where work happens.


For example, an onboarding app can use connectors to show progress from a business data source, surface learning resources, and update onboarding records. As another example, a field service app can retrieve product technical context from a third-party system, present guided steps, and write results back to connected systems. The result is a structured app experience that’s grounded in the data and services people use to get work done.


Connectors being used during creation of an app in Copilot Studio.


## Build enterprise apps with open standards and centralized control


Apps created in Copilot Cowork and Copilot Studio are **full-stack apps built using open standards** . They can use Git-backed source control, deployment stages, and version isolation so teams can continue improving the next version without disrupting the live experience.


By default, identity with[Microsoft Entra](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/business/microsoft-entra) , as well as organizational data and connector policies, are respected. IT administrators have centralized visibility in the Microsoft 365 admin center, which shows an inventory of published apps and operational controls to help govern, secure, and manage them throughout their lifecycle. Makers can focus on building and sharing solutions, while IT maintains the oversight needed to run them confidently across the organization.


IT admins can view and govern apps in the Microsoft 365 admin center.


## Start building apps with Copilot Studio


You can start building apps today by[joining the Frontier program](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365-copilot/frontier-program) and using the /app skill in Copilot Cowork. Access to app building natively within Copilot Studio is rolling out in public preview over the next week. When available in your environments, you’ll be able to open Copilot Studio, click the apps tile, and describe what you want to build using natural language. App building and running follows the[usage-based billing model](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-365/copilot/usage-based-billing-overview-copilot-credits) .


When published, apps appear in the Microsoft 365 admin center, giving administrators centralized visibility and controls to help govern them from the start. Users will be able to discover and use shared, enterprise-ready applications at[managedapps.cloud.microsoft.com](http://managedapps.cloud.microsoft.com/) .


With apps alongside agents and workflows in Copilot Studio, teams can **create complete, interactive business experiences** and move from an idea to an enterprise-ready solution. We will continue improving the experience as we learn from customers.


We look forward to seeing what you build.


## From idea to app


Create full-stack business apps through conversation with Copilot Cowork and Copilot Studio.
